Following pursuit is chronology, not evidence that pursuit caused a failure.

rejected_validation_attempt.cause: Previous release executable was copied before the concurrent build completed. Its hash equals the preserved before binary. The terminal-metrics assertion rejected it. validation-v2 uses the completed build; no source or policy tuning occurred.
